title: 37.5 SKADI: A 28nm Complete K-SAT Solver Featuring Dual-Path SRAM-Based Macro and Incremental Update with 100% Solvability
problem: K-SAT (Boolean satisfiability) solvers must handle both satisfiable (SAT) and unsatisfiable (UNSAT) cases with complete proofs; prior ASIC solvers are incomplete (SAT-only), while analog approaches suffer accuracy loss and digital methods face poor area/energy efficiency.
motivation: Complete K-SAT solving is essential for practical applications (EDA, formal verification, fault diagnosis) where satisfiability is unknown a priori; incomplete solvers cannot provide the proof of unsatisfiability required by these applications.
method: 28nm ASIC K-SAT solver using dual-path SRAM-based macro for bidirectional deduction (clauses→assignments and assignments→clauses), incremental state management via efficient assignment tracking, and multi-level clause state representation for 100% correctness, avoiding analog accuracy loss.
key_novelty: First complete ASIC K-SAT solver achieving bidirectional deduction with SRAM-based state management and guaranteed unsatisfiability proof.
contributions: First complete K-SAT solver ASIC (both SAT and UNSAT)
Dual-path SRAM-based macro for bidirectional deduction
primary_theme: Complete K-SAT solver ASIC with proof generation
